GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: urls
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Array of GeoJSON URLs to fetch. The GeoJSON features from the URL responses will be merged into one single FeatureCollection. When this trait is specified, the url trait is ignored.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: geoJsonData
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A geojson data object

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: geoJsonString
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A geojson string

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: responseGeoJsonPath
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Path to geojson in response. If API response is a list of json objects, this should be the path to the geojson within each object in the list.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: queryParameters
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Query parameters to supply to the API

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: updateQueryParameters
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Query parameters to supply to the API on subsequent calls after the first call.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: requestData
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: JSON body to be sent with the HTTP request to the server. If provided, the request will be made as POST rather than a GET.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: postRequestDataAsFormData
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Send the request data as form data instead of a JSON body.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: responseDataPath
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Path to relevant data in JSON response. eg: some.user.name, some.users[0].name or some.users[].name

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: attribution
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The attribution to display with the data.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: name
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the catalog item.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: description
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The description of the catalog item. Markdown and HTML may be used.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: hideDefaultDescription
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, then no generic default description will be displayed if description is undefined.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: nameInCatalog
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The name of the item to be displayed in the catalog, if it is different from the one to display in the workbench.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: info
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Human-readable information about this dataset.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: infoSectionOrder
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: An array of section titles defining the display order of info sections. If this property is not defined, {@link DataPreviewSections}'s DEFAULT_SECTION_ORDER is used

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: isOpenInWorkbench
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the item in the workbench open or collapsed.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReport
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A short report to show on the now viewing tab.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: shortReportSections
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A list of collapsible sections of the short report

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: isExperiencingIssues
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the catalog item is experiencing issues which may cause its data to be unavailable

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: hideSource
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Indicates that the source of this data should be hidden from the UI (obviously this isn't super-secure as you can just look at the network requests).

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: metadataUrls
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Metadata URLs to show in data catalog.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: dataUrls
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Data URLs to show in data catalog.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: dataCustodian
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Gets or sets a description of the custodian of this data item.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: modelDimensions
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: This provides ability to set model JSON through SelectableDimensions (a dropdown). When an option is selected, the value property will be used to call updateModelFromJson(). All string properties support Mustache templates (with the catalog member as context)

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableAboutData
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the 'About Data' button in the workbench.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: shareable
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: True (default) if this catalog member may be included in share links. False to exclude it from share links.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: workbenchControlFlags
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Flags for enabling or disabling workbench controls.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: ionAssetId
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The Cesium ion asset id. If this is set then the url is ignored

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: ionAccessToken
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Cesium ion access token. If not specified, the default token is used.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: ionServer
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: URL of the Cesium ion API server. If not specified, the default Ion server, https://api.cesium.com/, is used.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: chartPointOnMap
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The point on map where the current chart for the item was generated from. A marker will be shown at this point if the chart is active.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: chartType
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Type determines how the data availibility will be plotted on chart. eg: momentLines, momentPoints

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: chartDisclaimer
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A HTML string to show above the chart as a disclaimer

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: chartColor
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The color to use when the data set is displayed on the chart. The value can be any html color string, eg: 'cyan' or '#00ffff' or 'rgba(0, 255, 255, 1)' for the color cyan.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: chartGlyphStyle
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The glyph style to use for points plotted on the chart. Allowed values include circle, cross, diamond, square, star, triangle, wye. Default is "circle".

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: fromContinuous
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description:
Specifies how a continuous time (e.g. the timeline control) is mapped to a discrete time for this dataset. Valid values are:
* nearest - the nearest available discrete time to the current continuous time is used.
* next - the discrete time equal to or after the current continuous time is used.
* previous - the discrete time equal to or before the current continuous time is used.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: showInChartPanel
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether to plot data availability on a chart.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableDateTimeSelector
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, disables the date time selector in the workbench

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: multiplierDefaultDeltaStep
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The multiplierDefaultDeltaStep is used to set the default multiplier (see TimeVaryingTraits.multiplier trait) - it represents the average number of (real-time) seconds between (dataset) time steps. For example, a value of five would set the multiplier so that a new time step (of this dataset) would appear every five seconds (on average) if the timeline is playing. This trait will only take effect if multiplier is not explicitly set.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableExport
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Disable user export functionality

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: featureInfoUrlTemplate
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A template URL string for fetching feature info. Template values of the form {x} will be replaced with corresponding property values from the picked feature.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: maxRequests
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Max number of feature info requests to send to API url. Keep this number small to avoid sending to many requests to server (default 10).

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: enableManualRegionMapping
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If enabled, there will be controls to set region column and region type.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: useOutlineColorForLineFeatures
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If enabled, TableOutlineStyleTraits will be used to color Line Features, otherwise TableColorStyleTraits will be used.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: style
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Styling rules that follow simplestyle-spec. If defined, then forceCesiumPrimitives will be true. For styling MVT/protomaps - see TableStyleTraits

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: clampToGround
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the features in this GeoJSON should be clamped to the terrain surface. If forceCesiumPrimitives is false, this will be true

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: forceCesiumPrimitives
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Force rendering GeoJSON features as Cesium primitives. This will be true if you are using style, perPropertyStyles, timeProperty, heightProperty or czmlTemplate. If undefined, geojson-vt/protomaps will be used. This will be set to true if simplestyle-spec properties are detected in over 50% of GeoJSON features, or if any MultiPoint features are found

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: filterByProperties
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Filter GeoJSON features by properties. If the properties of a feature match filterByProperties, then show that feature. All other features are hidden

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: perPropertyStyles
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Override feature styles according to their properties. This is only supported for cesium primitives (see forceCesiumPrimitives)

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: timeProperty
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The property of each GeoJSON feature that specifies which point in time that feature is associated with. If not specified, it is assumed that the dataset is constant throughout time. This is only supported for cesium primitives (see forceCesiumPrimitives). If using geojson-vt styling, use TableTraits instead (see TableStyleTraits and TableTimeStyleTraits)

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: heightProperty
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The property of each GeoJSON feature that specifies the height. If defined, polygons will be extruded to this property (in meters) above terrain. This is only supported for cesium primitives (see forceCesiumPrimitives)

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: czmlTemplate
explodeMultiPoints
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Replaces MultiPoint features with its equivalent Point features when true. This is useful for example when using Table mode which does not support MultiPoint features currently.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableDepthTest
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, point features will render without depth testing so they remain visible through terrain and tiles.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: clustering
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Allows to activate the clustering of entities, works only with Cesium as a viewer.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: keepOnTop
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Keeps the layer on top of all other imagery layers.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: supportsReordering
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Does this layer support reordering in the workbench.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: legends
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The legends to display on the workbench.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: legendBackgroundColor
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Apply background color to all legends. This can be useful if legends are transparent and clash with Terria colours

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: hideLegendInWorkbench
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Whether the legend is hidden in the workbench for this catalog member.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: rectangle
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The bounding box rectangle that contains all the data in this catalog item.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: idealZoom
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Override default ideal zoom if the given values are valid.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disablePreview
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the preview on the Add Data panel. This is useful when the preview will be very slow to load.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableZoomTo
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Disables the zoom to (aka 'Ideal Zoom') button in the workbench.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: zoomOnAddToWorkbench
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Zoom to dataset when added to workbench. Doesn't work if disableZoomTo is true.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: show
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Show or hide a workbench item. When show is false, a mappable item is removed from the map and a chartable item is removed from the chart panel.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: initialMessage
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A message to show when the user adds the catalog item to the workbench. Useful for showing disclaimers.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: featureInfoTemplate
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: A template object for formatting content in feature info panel

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: showStringIfPropertyValueIsNull
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If the value of a property is null or undefined, show the specified string as the value of the property. Otherwise, the property name will not be listed at all.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: maximumShownFeatureInfos
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The maximum number of "feature infos" that can be displayed in feature info panel.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: preferredViewerMode
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The preferred viewer mode for this item - either '2d' '3d' or '3dsmooth'. If this dataset is used as a basemap then we automatically switch the viewer to the preferred mode. However the user can still switch to another mode, so this preference is not strongly enforced.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: opacity
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The opacity of the item.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableOpacityControl
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: When true, the user will be unable to change the opacity of the item

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: splitDirection
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The side of the splitter to display this imagery layer on. Defaults to both sides.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: disableSplitter
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If true, splitter funcitonality will be hidden for this model.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: showUnmatchedRegionsWarning
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: True to show a warning when some of the region IDs in the CSV file could not be matched to a region. False to silently ignore unmatched regions.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: columns
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Options for individual columns/variables.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: defaultColumn
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The default settings to use for all columns/variables

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: styles
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The set of styles that can be used to visualize this dataset.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: defaultStyle
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The default style to apply when visualizing any column/variable.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: activeStyle
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The ID of the currently-selected style.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: showDisableStyleOption
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If enabled, there will be an option in styleDimension to disable styling.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: showDisableTimeOption
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If enabled, there will be an checkbox to disable time.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: columnTitles
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: An optional array of column/variable titles that override the individual TableColumnTraits.title setting.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: columnUnits
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: An optional array of column/variable units that override the individual TableColumnTraits.unit setting.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: removeDuplicateRows
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: If two rows in the table are identical, only retain one copy. This could cause performance issues, and so should be used only when absolutely necessary.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: timeLabel
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Time label which is shown in workbench next to date/time selector (Will default to t($ => $.dateTime.selectorLabel") = "Time:).

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: currentTime
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The current time at which to show this dataset.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: initialTimeSource
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description:
The initial time to use if Current Time is not specified. Valid values are
* start - the dataset's start time
* stop - the dataset's stop time
* now - the current system time. If the system time is after Stop Time, Stop Time is used. If the system time is before Start Time, Start Time is used.
* none - do not automatically set an initial time
This value is ignored if Current Time is specified.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: startTime
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The earliest time for which this dataset is available. This will be the start of the range shown on the timeline control.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: stopTime
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The latest time for which this dataset is available. This will be the end of the range shown on the timeline control.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: multiplier
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The multiplier to use in progressing time for this dataset. For example, 5.0 means that five seconds of dataset time will pass for each one second of real time.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: isPaused
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: True if time is currently paused for this dataset, or false if it is progressing.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: dateFormat
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description:
A dateformat string (using the dateformat package) used to adjust the presentation of the date in various spots in the UI for a catalog item.
For example, to just show the year set to 'yyyy'. Used in places like the the Workbench Item and Bottom Dock

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: url
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: forceProxy
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.name: cacheDuration
GeoJsonCatalogItemTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

ApiRequestTraits.name: queryParameters
ApiRequestTraits.description: Query parameters to supply to the API

ApiRequestTraits.name: updateQueryParameters
ApiRequestTraits.description: Query parameters to supply to the API on subsequent calls after the first call.

ApiRequestTraits.name: requestData
ApiRequestTraits.description: JSON body to be sent with the HTTP request to the server. If provided, the request will be made as POST rather than a GET.

ApiRequestTraits.name: postRequestDataAsFormData
ApiRequestTraits.description: Send the request data as form data instead of a JSON body.

ApiRequestTraits.name: responseDataPath
ApiRequestTraits.description: Path to relevant data in JSON response. eg: some.user.name, some.users[0].name or some.users[].name

ApiRequestTraits.name: url
ApiRequestTraits.description: The base URL of the file or service.

ApiRequestTraits.name: forceProxy
ApiRequestTraits.description: Force the default proxy to be used for all network requests.

ApiRequestTraits.name: cacheDuration
ApiRequestTraits.description: The cache duration to use for proxied URLs for this catalog member. If undefined, proxied URLs are effectively cachable forever. The duration is expressed as a Varnish-like duration string, such as '1d' (one day) or '10000s' (ten thousand seconds).

QueryParamTraits.name: name
QueryParamTraits.description: The name of the query parameter.

QueryParamTraits.name: value
QueryParamTraits.description: The value of the query parameter. Parameter values starting with DATE!, eg. DATE!HH:MM, will be replaced wih the current date and time, formatted according to the format string following the !. For more information on the format string format, see the  dateformat library.

InfoSectionTraits.name: content
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section, in Markdown and HTML format. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: contentAsObject
InfoSectionTraits.description: The content of the section which is a JSON object. Set this property to null to remove this section entirely.

InfoSectionTraits.name: show
InfoSectionTraits.description: Indicates if this info section showing (not collapsed).

ShortReportTraits.name: show
ShortReportTraits.description: Indicates if this short report section showing.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: url
MetadataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

MetadataUrlTraits.name: title
MetadataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DataUrlTraits.name: type
DataUrlTraits.description:
Type of data URL. This value will be used to provide context or instruction on how to use the data URL. For example wcs will provide a link to WCS docs.
Current supported values are:
- wfs = A Web Feature Service (WFS) base URL
- wcs = A Web Coverage Service (WCS) base URL
- wfs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WCS server
-  wcs-complete = A complete, ready-to-use link to download features from a WFS server
-  direct = Direct URL to dataset (this is the default if no type is specified)
-  none = Hide data URL

DataUrlTraits.name: url
DataUrlTraits.description: The metadata URL of the file or service.

DataUrlTraits.name: title
DataUrlTraits.description: Title used for metadata URL button.

DimensionOptionTraits.name: value
DimensionOptionTraits.description: Value (if this is undefined, id will be used)

StyleTraits.name: marker-size
StyleTraits.description: Marker size. Valid values are small, medium, or large. If the value is a number, it is the size in pixels.

StyleTraits.name: marker-symbol
StyleTraits.description: Marker symbol. (only supported with Cesium Primitives)

StyleTraits.name: marker-url
StyleTraits.description: Marker URL. (only supported with Cesium Primitives)

StyleTraits.name: marker-stroke
StyleTraits.description: Marker stroke color. (This is will override stroke for Point geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

StyleTraits.name: marker-stroke-width
StyleTraits.description: Marker stroke width. (This is will override stroke-width for Point geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

StyleTraits.name: polyline-stroke
StyleTraits.description: Polyline stroke color. (This is will override stroke for Polyline geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

StyleTraits.name: polyline-stroke-width
StyleTraits.description: Polyline stroke width. (This is will override stroke-width for Polyline geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

StyleTraits.name: polygon-stroke
StyleTraits.description: Polygon stroke color. (This is will override stroke for Polygon geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

StyleTraits.name: polygon-stroke-width
StyleTraits.description: Polygon stroke width. (This is will override stroke-width for Polygon geojson-vt features) - not apart of simplestyle-spec and will not apply to cesium primitives

PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.name: properties
PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.description: If the properties of a feature match these properties, then apply the style to that feature

PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.name: style
PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.description: Styling rules to apply, following simplestyle-spec

PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.name: caseSensitive
PerPropertyGeoJsonStyleTraits.description: True if properties should be matched in a case sensitive fashion

ClusteringTraits.name: enabled
ClusteringTraits.description: True to enable clustering. False by default

ClusteringTraits.name: pixelRange
ClusteringTraits.description: The pixel range to extend the screen space bounding box

ClusteringTraits.name: minimumClusterSize
ClusteringTraits.description: The minimum number of screen space objects that can be clustered

ClusteringTraits.name: pinSize
ClusteringTraits.description: The size of the pin, in pixels

LegendTraits.name: title
LegendTraits.description: A title to be displayed above the legend.

LegendTraits.name: url
LegendTraits.description: The URL of the legend image. If the URL suffix isn't one of the following png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg, then urlMimeType must be defined - otherwise a hyperlink will be shown.

LegendTraits.name: imageScaling
LegendTraits.description: Scaling of the legend. For example, a high DPI legend may have scaling = 0.5, so it will be scaled down 50%

LegendTraits.name: urlMimeType
LegendTraits.description: The MIME type of the URL legend image. For example "image/png"

LegendTraits.name: backgroundColor
LegendTraits.description: Apply background color to entire legend. This can be useful if legend is transparent and clashes with Terria colours. This will override legendBackgroundColor.

LegendItemTraits.name: title
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleTitles
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple titles to display next to this legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: maxMultipleTitlesShowed
LegendItemTraits.description: Maximum number of multiple titles to display next to this legend item. (Default is 10)

LegendItemTraits.name: titleAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display above this legend item, i.e. marking the top of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: titleBelow
LegendItemTraits.description: The title to display below this legend item, i.e. marking the bottom of a box on the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: color
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color to display for this item. This property is ignored if Legend URL is specified.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineColor
LegendItemTraits.description: The CSS color with which to outline this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of outline in pixels

LegendItemTraits.name: outlineStyle
LegendItemTraits.description: The style of outline using CSS outline-style values. Eg 'dotted', 'dashed', 'solid', 'double', 'groove', 'ridge', 'inset', 'outset'

LegendItemTraits.name: multipleColors
LegendItemTraits.description: Multiple colors to show with this item in a grid arrangement.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageUrl
LegendItemTraits.description: The URL of an image to display with this item.

LegendItemTraits.name: marker
LegendItemTraits.description: Maki marker ID to display with this item (eg "circle").

LegendItemTraits.name: rotation
LegendItemTraits.description: The degrees to rotate legend item.

LegendItemTraits.name: addSpacingAbove
LegendItemTraits.description: True to add a bit of extra spacing above this item in order to separate it visually from the rest of the legend.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageHeight
LegendItemTraits.description: The height of the legend image.

LegendItemTraits.name: imageWidth
LegendItemTraits.description: The width of the legend image.

RectangleTraits.name: position
RectangleTraits.description: Position of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame in meters.

RectangleTraits.name: direction
RectangleTraits.description: The look direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

RectangleTraits.name: up
RectangleTraits.description: The up vector direction of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: x
VectorTraits.description: X component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: y
VectorTraits.description: Y component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

VectorTraits.name: z
VectorTraits.description: Z component of vector in the Earth-centered Fixed frame.

IdealZoomTraits.name: lookAt
IdealZoomTraits.description: Parameters for camera to look at a target.

IdealZoomTraits.name: camera
IdealZoomTraits.description: Use camera position, direction and up if fully defined. Otherwise use rectangle if fully defined.

LookAtTraits.name: targetLongitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target longitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetLatitude
LookAtTraits.description: Target latitude on the WGS84 ellipsoid in degrees

LookAtTraits.name: targetHeight
LookAtTraits.description: Target height in meters. Treat it as camera height. A positive value is above the WGS84 ellipsoid. Default to 100 meters.

LookAtTraits.name: heading
LookAtTraits.description: Heading in degrees. Treat it as camera bearing. North is 0. A positive value rotates clockwise, negative anti-clockwise. Default to 0.

LookAtTraits.name: pitch
LookAtTraits.description: Pitch in degrees. Treat it as camera pitch. A positive value is to look down, negative up. Default to 45.

LookAtTraits.name: range
LookAtTraits.description: The range in meters. It is the distance between the target position and camera position projected onto the local plane. Not negative and default to 500.

CameraTraits.name: position
CameraTraits.description: Position of the camera in the Earth-centered Fixed frame in meters.

CameraTraits.name: direction

TableColorStyleTraits.description: The maximum values of the bins to bin the data into, specified as an array of numbers. The first bin extends from the dataset's minimum value to the first value in this array. The second bin extends from the first value in this array to the second value in this array. And so on. If the maximum value of the dataset is greater than the last value in this array, an additional bin is added automatically. This property is ignored if the Color Column is not a scalar.

TableColorStyleTraits.name: binColors
TableColorStyleTraits.description: The colors to use for the bins, each specified as a CSS color string. If there are more colors than bins, the extra colors are ignored. If there are more bins than colors, the colors are repeated as necessary.

TableColorStyleTraits.description: The colors to use for enumerated values. This property is ignored if the Color Column type is not enum.

TableColorStyleTraits.name: colorPalette
TableColorStyleTraits.description:
The name of a ColorBrewer palette to use when mapping values to colors. This property is ignored if Bin Colors is defined and has enough colors for all bins, or if Enum Colors is defined. The default value depends on the type of the Color Column and on the data. Scalar columns that cross zero will use the diverging purple-to-orange palette PuOr. Scala columns that do not cross zero will use the sequential Red palette Reds. All other scenarios will use the 21 color HighContrast palette.
D3 color schemes are also supported (https://github.com/d3/d3-scale-chromatic) - but without scheme or interpolate string (for example - to use interpolateViridis - set colorPalette = Viridis).
This is case sensitive.

This value is magnitude of z-score - it will apply to positive and negative z-scores. For example a value of 2 will treat all values that are 2 or more standard deviations from the mean as outliers. This must be defined for it to be enabled. This will be ignored if minimumValue or maximumValue have been set

TableColorStyleTraits.name: zScoreFilterEnabled
TableColorStyleTraits.description: True, if z-score filter is enabled.

TableColorStyleTraits.name: rangeFilter
TableColorStyleTraits.description: This is applied after the zScoreFilter. It is used to effectively 'disable' the zScoreFilter if it doesn't cut at least the specified percentage of the range of values (for both minimum and maximum value). For example if rangeFilter = 0.2, then the zScoreFilter will only be effective if it cuts at least 20% of the range of values from the minimum and maximum value
